name: @superdurable/dex
description: TypeScript SDK for the Dex durable workflow engine

scripts.prepack: npm run build:native && npm run build
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:native && npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/test/integ/*.integration.test.js
scripts.test:integration:coverage: npm run build:native && npm run build && c8 node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/test/integ/*.integration.test.js && node scripts/report-uncovered.mjs coverage/lcov.info
scripts.test: npm run build:native && npm run build && node --test dist/test/*.test.js
